name: wheel
advice: Tyre and rim as one 6-8 sided prism with the rim painted.
Picture: the tyre is a rounded drum of 400-670 triangles with spokes; a few pixels on screen, a 6-8 sided prism with the rim painted.
Remove its 64 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
2 round part(s) (cylinders, prisms): thin ones as boxes without caps or 3-sided prisms and the fake rounded-corner shader; caps that touch another part left out.
No level of detail: add ~50% levels (meshoptimizer simplify, weld first) and an impostor or nothing past a few pixels.
36 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
